subject: McGear: Renewal & new workloads — synthesis and next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Foster <alex@mcgear.io>
Cc: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@mcgear.io>
Date: 2027-05-28T16:12:00Z
Subject: McGear: Renewal & new workloads — synthesis and next steps

Alex / Lisa — thanks again for a focused call today. I wanted to capture what we heard, surface one quick clarification, and propose concrete next steps so we keep momentum toward your July renewal decision.

Recap (what you told us)
- Current pain: inference tail latency spikes for user-facing features during morning traffic bursts; token costs have risen ~22% YoY due to increased prompt length and more RAG queries.
- Goal: move from ad-hoc hosted usage to predictable unit economics for chat + RAG by H2 while keeping p99 latency < 350ms for core flows.
- New workloads: batch-document embeddings for search indexing (~50k docs/month), a new summarization endpoint for customer support (short summaries, high throughput).

Constraints / notes from the call
- Security: must remain SOC2-compliant; McGear prefers VPC peering but is open to Redwood Dedicated if the pricing delta is justified.
- Timeline: procurement wants options and rough numbers by 6/10; renewal effective date 8/1.

Initial recommendation (high level)
- Short term (pilot): Enable caching + prefix-KV for chat flows and a small Dedicated pilot for the summarization endpoint (2x A100-equivalent) to lock latency.
- Mid term (H2): Evaluate Dedicated reserved capacity for production embedding batch jobs and move high-volume RAG queries to quantized model variants.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) I’ll share a Mutual Value Roadmap and two cost scenarios (hosted vs dedicated) — attached.
2) Alex/Lisa: confirm the expected monthly embedding/doc counts and the SLA floor you need for summarization (p95/p99 targets).
3) If procurement wants, we can schedule a short 30-minute cost walkthrough next week (available 6/1 or 6/3).

Attachments: MCGear_mutual_value_roadmap.xlsx, cost-scenarios-dedicated-vs-hosted.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the documents and a suggested calendar slot.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

From: Alex Foster <alex@mcgear.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@mcgear.io>
Date: 2027-05-28T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: McGear: Renewal & new workloads — synthesis and next steps

Thanks, Sergio — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Embeddings: projected run-rate is 45k–60k docs/month depending on retention window; initial pilot 10k/month.
- Summarization SLA: we expect p95 < 250ms for the short summaries; p99 is negotiable but should be < 450ms.
- Security: SOC2 is required and we need evidence of audit logs for inference requests (retention 90 days).

Procurement note (Lisa): we’d like the hosted vs dedicated cost comparison to include an uplift scenario (20% growth) and an ops-support add-on. Can you include a simple churn-adjusted forecast?

Two asks:
1) Please send the roadmap + cost scenarios (we’ll review with engineering).
2) We’ll aim for the 6/3 slot for the cost walkthrough; can you propose 9–9:30am PT or 1–1:30pm PT?

Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | McGear
alex@mcgear.io

Subject: RE: McGear: Renewal & new workloads — synthesis and next steps

Alex / Lisa — attached are the two files we discussed: the Mutual Value Roadmap (tabbed: pilot, H2 scale, KPIs) and three cost scenarios (conservative, baseline, growth with 20% uplift). Highlights: 

- Pilot proposal: 4-week pilot for summarization on a Dedicated slice sized to meet p95 200–250ms; expected cost delta vs hosted: ~18% higher but with predictable unit cost and reserved throughput.
- Embeddings: for 50k docs/month the hosted estimate is lower short-term; however, with steady growth and indexing windows the Dedicated reserved capacity starts to look favorable at ~9–12 months.
- Ops/support: we included a premium SLA line for 24/7 incident support and a one-time onboarding fee.

Attachments (same as listed):
- MCGear_mutual_value_roadmap.xlsx (tabs: summary, pilot-scope, KPIs)
- cost-scenarios-dedicated-vs-hosted.pdf (3 scenarios + assumptions)

Proposed cadence:
- 6/3 cost walkthrough (I’ll propose 09:00 PT and 13:00 PT; please accept whichever works).
- After that, we’ll update the roadmap and produce a one-page pilot SOW to route to procurement.

Action items (owner):
- Alex: confirm preferred walkthrough time and embedding run-rate to lock assumptions.
- Lisa: confirm whether McGear needs a PO template or DocuSign-ready quote for procurement.
- Monica (cc): I’ve looped Monica from CS to map the pilot SOW and acceptance criteria.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-05-30T14:30:00Z
Subject: RE: McGear: Renewal & new workloads — synthesis and next steps

Looping in a short technical note and an internal ask — hi Alex / Lisa, quick hello from Redwood CS.

Technical note: based on the requirements (p95 ~250ms and 50k embedding docs/month) I recommend we size the pilot Dedicated slice to 2x A100-equivalent with continuous batching enabled and prefix caching for chat flows. We should also baseline KV cache hit rate during the 2-week observation window to set realistic p99 targets.

Internal ask (Sergio / Monica): please add a one-paragraph acceptance criteria to the pilot SOW covering latency targets (p95/p99), throughput (qps), and data retention/audit log access. Monica, I suggest we use the standard pilot SOW template and add the KV-cache metrics.

I’ll join the 6/3 walkthrough — Sergio, please send the calendar invite once Alex confirms a time.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com
